 RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 OUT: Download CEN 05/2026 Hall Ticket PDF at rrb.digialm.com
 By Deepanshu Upadhayaya Last Updated: Nov 20, 2026, 07:25 IST RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards have released the CBT admit card for candidates appearing in the Paramedical staff examination. Candidates can download their hall tickets from the respective regional RRB websites using their login credentials. Check the direct download link and other important details here.
 RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 OUT: Download CEN 05/2026 Hall Ticket PDF at rrb.digialm.com Key Points
 The RRB Paramedical CBT Admit Card 2026 was released on November 19, 2026.
 The Computer Based Examination will be conducted on November 23 and 25, 2026.
 Candidates can download admit cards for 590 vacancies from regional RRB websites.
 RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB) has officially released the RRB Paramedical CBT Admit Card 2026 on November 19, 2026. The Computer Based Examination will be conducted on November 23 and 25, 2026 across various examination centres. Candidates who have applied for this recruitment can now download their hall tickets from the official regional RRB websites using their login credentials. Through this recruitment drive a total of 590 vacancies would be filled across various posts such as Pharmacist, Health & Malaria Inspector Grade 2, Nursing Superintendent Lab Assistant Grade II, Radiographer X-Ray Technician. 
 Check this article for the direct download link, important details, steps to download and documents required for the examination . 
 RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 Download PDF Link 
 The RRB Paramedical CBT Admit Card 2026 download link has been activated on the respective regional RRBs. Candidates can download their e call letters by entering their registration number, user password and security pin. The admit card contains important details such as the examination date, shift timing, reporting time and examination centre. Check the direct link to download CEN 05/2026 hall ticket below.

 How to Download RRB Paramedical CBT Admit Card 2026? 
 Candidates can follow the steps below to download the RRB Paramedical Hall Ticket 2026 
 Visit the official website of the respective regional Railway Recruitment Board. 
 Now click on the e call letter link RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 under CEN 05/2026. 
 Enter your registration number and date of birth or password. 
 Submit the login details to download your hall ticket. 
 Check the examination date, shift timing and centre details. 
 Download the admit card and take a printout for the exam day. 
 Details Mentioned on Railway RRB Paramedical CBT Hall Ticket 2026 PDF 
 The RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 generally contains the following details- 
 Candidate  Name 
 Roll Number 
 Registration Number 
  Photograph and Signature 
 Date of Birth 
 Exam Name and Post 
 Examination Date 
 Exam Shift and Timing 
 Reporting Time 
 Examination Centre Name and Address 
 Exam Centre Code 
 Important Exam Day Instructions 
 Guidelines for Entry to the Examination Hall 
 Documents to Carry Along with RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026 
 Candidates must carry the following documents to the examination centre- 
 A printed copy of the RRB Paramedical Admit Card 2026. 
 A valid original photo identity proof such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Passport or Driving Licence. 
 A passport size photograph as given in the admit card instructions. 
 For more details candidates are advised to visit the official website regularly.
